description: A mandatory gate (identity, kill switch, registry, operation, role boundary, scope, environment, resource, data class, parameters, tool authorization) failed. Human approval cannot override this.
The financial request breaks a limit that no approval can lift.
The amount exceeds the agent's autonomous spending limits; a human must approve this exact transaction.
The operation, or the agent's registry entry, requires human approval for this operation.
The risk score meets or exceeds the escalation threshold.
Every gate passed; the request is inside the boundary humans approved for this agent.
